youtube.title: How to Respond to Leads Fast: A 4-Line Reply for Plumbing, HVAC and Roofing Owners
youtube.description:
How to respond to leads fast, for plumbing, HVAC, roofing and home service business owners.
In 11.6 million Fiverr requests, freelancers who replied a day late were about 90% less likely to get hired, and an hour late about half as likely ("Speed Is a Signal: When Faster Replies Increase Hiring Likelihood," Management Science, 2026). Thumbtack's 2025 Pro Summit: pros who reply within 30 minutes are 25% more likely to get hired than pros who reply within 3 hours.

The 4-line reply:
1. Hi [name],
2. yes, we replace water heaters.
3. Gas or electric?
4. I can come by tomorrow, 2 to 4.

Fast, human, one question, a time. Send this to whoever answers your phone.
Next lesson: how to follow up on a quote that went quiet.
Free tools for trade owners at proofnotfluff.com
Narrated by an AI version of my own voice.
